regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure in China A-shares: Banks (rank 1) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2) both with high scores and active breadth, but the rotation gap is razor-thin (0.01) and the breadth of rotation is just 18% of themes. Critically for this market, the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold historically (gate_helps=false), so the one validated edge (drawdown control) is absent here; the backtest verdict explicitly labels this tape as mean-reverting and the allocation as experimental/display. Given the 77-call track record with 37.7% directional accuracy, conviction must default low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the Banks–Pharma margin (currently 0.01) widens decisively beyond 0.10 in either direction over the next 10 sessions — a confirmed handoff would retire this two-leader ambiguity; until then both remain co-leaders in a narrow rotation.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed leader with the highest durability_bar (0.73), strongest breadth (0.889, indicating broad participation rather than a narrow squeeze), and score 0.998. This is a leadership/FOCUS observation, not a return forecast; the mean-reverting tape (gate_helps=false) and crowded flag (crowding_z 1.78) mean this is a size-down caution context, not a high-conviction directional call. On a mean-reverting market, being long the most durable, broadest theme is the least-bad default if one must lean at all.
evidence: crowding_z 1.78 / crowded=true (sizing caution only, per guardrails)
theses.dissent: Banks are the most crowded theme in the set, and on a historically mean-reverting tape the leader is exactly where reflexivity-topping risk concentrates; with directional accuracy at 37.7%, a high-conviction bullish lean on the crowded leader has poor expected value.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS trails CSI 300 by 5% on a 20-day basis before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the only credible challenger with score 0.988, eligible=true, and durability_bar 0.60 — the second-highest durability in the universe. The margin to Banks is just 0.01, and breadth 0.643 is healthy. It offers diversification away from the single crowded leader while retaining eligible-trend status. Both top themes are crowded, so this is a modest lean, not a size-up call.
theses.dissent: Pharma & CXO is also crowded (crowding_z 1.59) and rotation timing has no validated forward edge — the near-tie with Banks could resolve either way, and on a mean-reverting market both leaders can roll over together.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ underperforms CSI 300 by more than 4% over any 15-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Battery & Lithium
theses.thesis: Battery & Lithium sits at rank 18 with score -0.64, eligible=false, hurst_tag 'mixed', and the most negative crowding_z in the set (-1.28, i.e. abandoned by flow). On a mean-reverting tape this is NOT a fade/short call — rather, it is a flag that this theme currently shows no leadership, no durability (bar 0.27), and thin participation (breadth 0.188). The lean is expressed as underweight/avoid relative to an allocation, never as a short.
evidence: crowding_z -1.28 (deeply out of favor; no flow support)
theses.dissent: Exactly because the tape mean-reverts and this theme is the most washed-out by crowding_z, a snap-back rally is the classic contrary outcome — the detector's own guardrails warn against fading, and an underweight here can cost if mean-reversion picks up.

falsifier.text: 515030.SZ beats CSI 300 by 8% on a 20-day basis before the check-by date.
